meta.name: performance
meta.description: Optimize web performance for faster loading and better user experience. Use when asked to "speed up my site", "optimize performance", "reduce load time", "fix slow loading", "improve page speed", or "performance audit".

copy.tagline: 加速网站加载，提升用户体验
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的网站加载慢、需要性能优化
copy.tagline_en: Speed up your website for better user experience
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your website loads slowly and needs performance optimization

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会分析网页性能瓶颈，提供优化建议和代码示例，包括资源加载、图片、字体、缓存、运行时性能等，并给出性能预算和关键指标目标。
howto.when: 当用户要求“加速我的网站”、“优化性能”、“减少加载时间”、“修复加载慢”、“提升页面速度”或“性能审计”时触发。

say.text: 帮我优化网站性能，减少加载时间。
say.note: Claude 会分析并提供具体优化方案。

say.text: 我的页面加载慢，请做性能审计。
say.note: Claude 会识别瓶颈并给出改进建议。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes web performance bottlenecks and provides optimization suggestions with code examples, covering resource loading, images, fonts, caching, runtime performance, and sets performance budgets and key metric targets.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to "speed up my site", "optimize performance", "reduce load time", "fix slow loading", "improve page speed", or "performance audit".

say_en.text: Help me optimize my site's performance and reduce load time.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and provide specific optimizations.

say_en.text: My page loads slowly, please do a performance audit.
say_en.note: Claude will identify bottlenecks and suggest improvements.
